author: Times Radio
description:
“I think AI unmanaged can cause a lot of damage, as we’ve already seen. I think the companies providing this technology have to take more responsibility to ensure that it’s tested.”

Tech companies need to take responsibity to use AI in a responsible way and to ensure that AI programmes are tested before being made available to users, says Senior Vice President of Kyndryl Consult, Ismail Amla.

Ismail Amla was talking to Adam Boulton on Times Radio. Listen live every Sunday 10am-1pm.

"If a tag is not fitted for two days, and in some cases two weeks or longer, there is a risk of further offending."

His Majesty’s Chief Inspector of Probation, Martin Jones argues for a “more robust approach” to probation tagging, adding that “it would have made sense to think about whether some people could be tagged as they left prison” to avoid re-offending.

Martin Jones was speaking to Rosie Wright and Calum Macdonald on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every Friday-Sunday, 6-10am.
